releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.4.5

- Gives each approved coaching request its own stable Intervals.icu identifier.
- Keeps separate same-day warm-up, TT Pace, and between-race re-warm workouts from replacing one another.
- Retains exact duplicate repair so a retried request still cannot produce repeated copies.
- Simplifies eFTP automation to one Intervals.icu FTP checkbox; percentage-based TT Pace workouts scale from that configured value and are not rewritten.
- Discovers possible races from optional calendars, keeps Entered athlete-specific, and creates TT Pace only for an entered time trial after its course has been reviewed.
- Gives Bike Coach official event pages and route links for strategy, while keeping road races separate from TT workout creation.
- Stops for review when an official page lists several or conflicting course distances instead of silently choosing one.
